true_answer: • The complete inverse image of an element y in the codomain, writ- ten f − 1 ( y ) , is the set of all elements in the domain which are assigned to y by the function. • The image of a subset A of the domain is the set f ( A ) | { f ( a )∈ Y : a ∈ A } . • The inverse image of a a subset B of the codomain is the set f − 1 ( B ) | { x ∈ X : f ( x )∈ B } .
